text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though defeated by TM Opera O, Meisho Doto 
is thrilled they were able to achieve a 
one-two finish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, watching the race, Air Shakur 
stated that the two had hit their growth 
ceiling—and that the current hierarchy was 
the previous generation > Opera O > Doto.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Does a ceiling really exist? And if it 
does, can it be shattered? Carrying 
lingering doubts, she heads toward her 
next race, the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
